metadata.description: Book a meeting using a specified meeting link.
metadata.learn_more: Book a meeting using a specified meeting link. This endpoint allows you to create a meeting by providing necessary details such as duration, email, and start time. It is useful for scheduling meetings programmatically through HubSpot's API.

duration.label: Duration
duration.description: An integer representing the duration of the meeting in minutes.

email.label: Email
email.description: The email address of the person booking the meeting.

firstName.label: First Name
firstName.description: The first name of the person booking the meeting.

formFields.label: Form Fields
formFields.description: An array of form fields filled out by the participant, each containing a name and value.

lastName.label: Last Name
lastName.description: The last name of the person booking the meeting.

legalConsentResponses.label: Legal Consent Responses
legalConsentResponses.description: An array of legal consent responses, each detailing the consent given by the participant.

likelyAvailableUserIds.label: Likely Available User Ids
likelyAvailableUserIds.description: An array of strings representing the user IDs of those likely available for the meeting.

locale.label: Locale
locale.description: A string representing the locale of the person booking the meeting.

slug.label: Slug
slug.description: A string representing the unique identifier for the meeting link.

startTime.label: Start Time
startTime.description: The start time of the meeting in ISO 8601 date-time format.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: A string representing the timezone of the person booking the meeting.
